card.name: Inside split medical term spellings
card.fires_on: The odd split piece in the middle of a longer medical word, where the word is broken into pieces, e.g. the "h" in sedatives/hypnotics, "B" in Sodium Bicarbonate, or "ph" in Prophylaxis.

modes.label: Drug class and drug names
modes.description: Split pieces inside drug names or drug classes such as sedative-hypnotics, sodium bicarbonate, tranylcypromine.
